verdict.rationale: Column exposes raw rail-level data (full wire messages), a unified cross-rail transfer query endpoint, structured reports (transaction/summary in CSV/JSON/Parquet), webhooks, and account-number-based permissioning that a commenter praised as enabling per-counterparty limits — all supporting building rich in-product transaction views. However, there is no explicit documentation of counterparty-detail enrichment (e.g., merchant/payer name normalization) or dedicated 'enrichment' features beyond raw rail metadata. missing for 10: explicit counterparty enrichment/normalization docs, evidence of stable cross-transaction identifiers beyond account numbers, independent hands-on validation of data richness.
